title: Washington Federal Receipts Final Reconstruction v0.1

accounting_architecture.national_control: OMB Historical Tables complete federal receipts universe
accounting_architecture.washington_reconstruction: Sum of independently certified Washington component allocations
accounting_architecture.withheld_treatment: National control preserved; no Washington amount imputed
accounting_architecture.intentionally_unallocable_treatment: National control preserved outside Washington allocated numerator
accounting_architecture.irs_gross_collections: Independent administrative benchmark; diagnostic comparison only

boundaries: No new state-allocation methodology introduced in ETL-172J-5.
Health Insurance Providers remains WITHHOLD_UNRESOLVED where the national control is nonzero.
Customs duties and fees, Federal Reserve deposits, and miscellaneous all-other receipts remain intentionally unallocable under the certified methodology crosswalk.
ETL-171 IRS gross collections are diagnostic only and are not forced to reconcile with the economic-incidence reconstruction.
No final taxes-out minus spending-in balance is authorized by this stage.
